testimonies.name: Joe Schwed, CSP, CHST
testimonies.affiliation: Head of Health, Safety and Wellbeing at JFK Terminal 1
testimonies.quote: Mental health and well-being are just as important as any other aspect of safety on our projects. I've always supported efforts that encourage workers to speak up, look out for one another, and get help when they need it. Protecting Under the Hard Hat builds on that commitment by providing workers and their families with resources they can access and use when it matters most.

testimonies.name: Ed Campbell
testimonies.affiliation: Foreman at Waters & Bugbee, Construction and General Laborers' Union Local 172
testimonies.quote: I think it is a good initiative where if we can answer something anonymously and get the resources that we need it can really help the construction industry.
